messages.subject: For Estelle Brachlianoff | Ecological transformation, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Obadia,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Estelle Brachlianoff, Chief Executive Officer.

Veolia's water, waste and energy businesses sit at the intersection of governments, communities, environmental commitments and complex operating execution. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters across corporate and technical teams, and I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and a carbon-accounting evidence pilot.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy, ESG and institutional coordination might support Veolia's ecological-transformation priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Veolia.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
